title_en: What do you do on the weekend?
paras_en: Hello, my name is Nerry and I am from Belize. My question today is, what do you do on the weekend?

On the weekend, I like to rest and clean my house. I sweep the floor and mop the floor, and I do laundry. I also do self-care, such as getting my nails done, getting my hair done, or getting my eyelashes done. The weekends is usually laidback and slow for me. I rest and prepare myself for the new week. I prepare myself by meditating, reflecting on journaling in my book.
My question to you is what do you do on the weekend?

title_en: Beginner English - 9 - Do you buy dinner at the supermarket?
paras_en: Hello, my name is Rocio and I am from El Salvador. My question is, do you buy dinner at the supermarket?

Do I buy dinner at the supermarket? Sometimes whenever I'm busy, I buy dinner. At the supermarket, they have pre-made foods that are very easy to heat up. I like to buy sushi or rice with vegetables, but I don't like to buy fast food because it's not very healthy. I also don't like frozen meals because they don't taste really fresh. So I buy vegetables and chicken and cook at home. The supermarket is very convenient for me whenever I am busy because it has many options for pre-made food. But I prefer to cook if there is time.
And do you buy dinner at the supermarket?

title_en: What are your plans for tonight?
paras_en: Hi. In this video I'm going to talk a little bit about my plans for tonight. So right now I am at a park.

You can kind of see the park here, and I'm going to go running. I'm going to run for about 40 minutes and I am going to get some exercise I really need to run. I try to run one hour every day, and then after I run, I'm going to take some photos of the park because I love this park and I'm going to share them with my friends. I'm going to post on Facebook, and then after that I am going to drive home, and then I'm going to have dinner with my family. I think tonight we're going to have pizza, although I'm not sure. And then after dinner, I think I'm going to relax and chat with my mom and my dad, and then I'm going to go to bed early. I'm not going to stay up late because tomorrow I have to get up early because I'm going to drive to another city and I'm going to meet my niece and nephew because my nephew is getting married. So I'm going to be doing a lot of things, so I'm going to be very busy.

title_en: Beginner English - 11 - Do you cook often or much?
paras_en: Hi, my name is Billy and I live in South Africa. Today I'm going to talk about whether I cook a lot. Do I cook often or much?

Yes, I have a big family and I enjoy cooking, so I love making different cuisines, different foods from different places. I love my Asian foods. I love making miso soup. That's Japanese and I love eating buns, pork buns, that's Chinese. I also enjoy my spaghetti, my rice, pasta, everything. I love food in general, so I do enjoy cooking and I do try to cook much despite my busy schedule.
So yeah, I hope to have more time to cook, but for now I enjoy the time. I do have. Bye.

title_en: Beginner English - 12 - Is your town nice?
paras_en: Hello, my name is Elizabeth and I am from America. My question is, is your town nice?

Yes, my town is nice. It is a small town. It is not big. It is not busy. It has five really nice coffee shops. It has a university. There are nice parks here. It does not have a lot of shops for shopping, but it is near a bigger town. I have lived in this town for three years. I do not want to move. I am happy here.
My question for you is, is your town nice?

title_en: What cold drinks do you like in the summer?
paras_en: Hello, my name is Haal and I'm from Turkey. My question is, what cold drinks do you like in the summer?

I enjoy cold drinks because they are very refreshing and very nice. One of my favorite cold drinks is water with ice, because it is very simple and very healthy. I also like to drink orange juice because orange juice is also healthy and it is very sweet. Sometimes I drink iced tea, but I like my iced tea with lemon because lemon makes it taste better. I like to drink milkshake too, but my favorite milkshake is strawberry milkshake because I love strawberries.
How about you? What cold drinks do you like to drink?

title_en: Beginner English - 14 - How was your day?
paras_en: Hi everyone. This is your teacher, Todd and I will talk about my day.

So today I had a really good day. I woke up early and I read for a bit. I read a book that I love. It's got a really, really good story. And then I took a drive. I drove down here to the countryside and I walked along the rice fields here and I just relaxed.

Then I went to the beach and I sat on the beach and just did nothing. I did nothing. I just sat there and I looked out at the ocean and just cleared my mind. It was a really nice day. So it was a really fun Sunday. I felt relaxed all day and I didn't feel stressed, and now I'm ready for work tomorrow. So, yeah, it was a good day.
I didn't buy anything. Oh wait, I did. I bought lunch, but besides that, I didn't buy anything.

title_en: Beginner English - 15 - Do you use the train or bus?
paras_en: Hello, my name is Lisa. I am from Ukraine. My question is, do you use the train or bus?

I use the bus in my city. If I go to the supermarket, I use the bus, but I don't like the bus. If I travel, if I go to another city, if I travel to another country, I don't like the bus. I like the train. I travel by train to other country or other city.
Do you like the train or the bus?
Hi, my name is Nerissa and I'm from the Philippines. My question is, what drinks do you dislike?

I dislike coconut juice and beer. Coconut juice tastes weird to me, and I can't eat or drink anything with coconut. I also don't like beer because it's too bitter for me. I don't enjoy it. Maybe because I don't drink alcohol often. When I have to drink beer with my family members and friends, I make sure that the beer is very cold, and then I drink soda afterward to wash off the taste.
What about you? What drinks do you dislike?
Hello, my name is Nerry, and I am from Belize. My question today is, what food is not healthy?

Fried chicken wings is not healthy. To make it healthy, I prepare it in the air-fryer. Fried chicken wings is not healthy because it is greasy and it is made by frying the wings in oil. The air fryer fries the wings without oil making it very delicious and healthy.
My question for you today is what?
Food is not healthy?

title_en: Beginner English - 17 - Are clothing shops cheap in your town?
paras_en: Hello there. My name is Rocio and I'm from El Salvador. My question is, are clothing shops cheap in your town? Are clothing shops cheap in my town?

In my town, there are a lot of different options when you buy clothes, but local thrift shops are the most common. They are very cheap and they have a lot of clothes, but the quality may not always be the best. For better quality, you can go to big stores at the mall, but they can be really expensive. Sometimes shops have sales and prices are lower, but it really depends on where you are looking and on the season.
So I'd say that clothes are fairly cheap in El Salvador, but it really depends on the store and on where you are looking.
And you are clothing shops in your town cheap?
Hi everybody, this is Todd, and now I am in Taiwan. Actually, I'm in the city Tai Chung. And Tai Chiang is near Taipei.

It is a big city. It is a modern city, and it is a very nice city. It is near Taipei. It is about one hour away by train, and the city has many nice things. The streets are clean, the people are nice, the food is delicious. Now it is summer, so the weather is warm, although today is a wet day because there is some rain, but that's okay.

Actually, there is a typhoon nearby, but the typhoon is not in this city. This typhoon is not coming to this city, but it is coming very close. I am here for a conference, and the conference is at a university. It is tomorrow. It is on Saturday, so I'm excited about that. And now I'm just enjoying this great city.
As you can see, it is busy, it is lively. It's a lot of fun here, and I really like it.
How about your city? Is your city fun? Is your city clean? Is it big? Is it modern? Is it warm? Is it expensive?
Most of all, I hope your city is a nice place to live.
